description:
Discover checked Florida or California launch/trailer and beach parking guides. Supply state, optionally an exact guide ID; omit id to list available guides and IDs. Returns official sources, checkedAt (research date, not publication time), entrance directions when researched, permit/fee/access guidance, construction notices and published capacity where supplied. Coverage is selected locations, not every launch. Unknown IDs return no guide. availability is always null: no live occupancy, opening or reopening feed is connected. Never substitute ordinary car-lot parking for trailer permission. Facility inventory is available through get_poi_details for supported Florida POI IDs.

Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_parking_guides
title: Get checked parking guides
